title: Closing the scalar slice does not pay the coupled general-U terms
statement:
Completed general-U audit retains E=Q+sP+s^2A,A=,U=sigma a+d,P=<2aU^2-(r+2)a^2U+r c^2U-2bcU-kappa a^3-kappa ac^2>. Weighted Hodge(sigma f,g)=(psi_y,-psi_x)+(chi_x,chi_y) gives a=(q+chi_xx)/sigma,b=(w+chi_xy)/sigma,c=-p+chi_xy,d=-q+chi_yy,U=Delta chi. Acoustic term includes genuine mixed -2kappa

;quadratic minimization does not remove cubic/quartic mixed terms. At r1,psi=cos(x+y),chi=t psi,actual compatible energy has E_(1/5)-E_0=-s^2/10-27/256<0,although both positive: no universal nonnegative chi reserve. Unchanged pointwise transfer at F0=[[1,0],[1,0]],r1/10 has -17/2800;actual f=g=sinx average -51/22400. These refute particular transfer/reserve,not original conformal Jensen or QC. Cubic defect noncollinear-triad multiplier (k cross l)^2 sum_i k_ix k_iy/6;no nonzero homogeneous local cubic Hessian null identity can replace it. Original scalar slice and general-U discriminant P^2<=4AQ are separate;full affine QC further obligations. Later producer proofN1496 earns strict ORIGINAL U-free QC at EVERY full affine mean for finite r>=3/4,without a uniform modulus,and constructs a CORRECTED globally QC quartic preserving original value/first normal jet. It does not close unmodified varying-general-U QC. Earlier audited false bridge,Hodge mixed terms and failed nonnegative reserves remain valid. New fixed-fiber normal cost can be negative while total corrected/uncorrected gaps stay positive;Jensen-gap26.24%reduction is not26%totalenergy (total~.90%). Priorv1audit acceptance remains at that actual historical scope;new coupling claims are producer-completed,not newly audited.

Neither failure refuted the original N901 target. The new code rebuilds the original cubic directly; it does not restore that identity or the failed unchanged general-U transfer.
